decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for alterations to existing balconies   
           to change the panels  from Georgian wired steel to light siver grey   
           powder coated galvanised perforated steel and to alter the gap at the 
           bottom to 45mm at Charlton House, because of the position, design 
           and appearance of the building, would be acceptable having due 
           regard for the site characteristics of  this block of flats and would not be 
           detrimental to its appearance  and the character of the street scene or 
           to the amenities nearby properties.  
           The development is in accordance with the UDP policies  ENV-B.1.1 
           (New Development) and  H 6.1  (Housing Improvements) of The 
           London Borough of Hounslow UDP,  Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the panels are inserted.
description: Alterations to existing balconies to alter the gap at the bottom to 45mm and change the panels to perforated steel.
